scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/storefront && npm run build --workspace=apps/admin && npm run build --workspace=apps/partner
scripts.test:go: npm run test:api && npm run test:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/cloudflare-gateway/wrangler.jsonc && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/storefront/wrangler.jsonc && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/admin/wrangler.jsonc && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/partner/wrangler.jsonc && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:storefront: npm run build:storefront && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/storefront/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build:admin && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/admin/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:partner: npm run build:partner && npx wrangler deploy --config apps/partner/wrangler.jsonc
